subject: bumblebee bat
title: The Shortest Mammal on Earth Weighs Less Than a Penny

scenes.text: This mammal weighs less than a US penny.
It's Kitti's hog-nosed bat, nicknamed the bumblebee bat.
Its body is about an inch long, and it weighs around two grams.
No mammal on Earth has a shorter body.
It lives in a few limestone caves in Thailand and Myanmar, and wasn't described by science until 1974.
A penny weighs two and a half grams. This bat loses.

description:
Kitti's hog-nosed bat, the bumblebee bat, has a body about 29 to 33 mm long and weighs about 1.7 to 2 grams, the smallest mammal by length.
It lives in limestone caves in western Thailand and southeast Myanmar and was described in 1974. A US penny weighs 2.5 grams.
What's the smallest animal you've seen up close?
